resultsui.title: Run results
resultsui.summary.partial: Results summary · not a full scan
resultsui.summary.noKaratRound: No karat for a partial run; the karat is from round {round}.
resultsui.summary.noKarat: No karat for a partial run.
resultsui.summary.cancelledNoKarat: No karat was computed because the run did not complete.
resultsui.stale: The code changed since the full scan; start a full scan to compute the karat.
resultsui.forYou.scope: Within the karat’s scope ({checks, plural, =0 {no required checks} one {# required check} other {# required checks}}): {counts}.
resultsui.term.blocked: A verdict that prevents “Pure” because a blocking check failed, whatever the karat.
resultsui.term.incomplete: No blocking failure, but items are still open: missing checks, reviews or warnings.
resultsui.term.pure: Every required check passed, and integrity holds.
resultsui.term.standardsProfile: The checks you approved for your project, and which are required for the karat.
resultsui.next.none: {count, plural, one {# check} other {# checks}} passed with saved evidence. Why: {reason}
resultsui.forModel.preview: This is a preview of exactly what will be copied for the chosen scope. Redaction marks stay in the copied text as {marker}.
resultsui.forModel.blocked: This report cannot be copied or exported: a high-confidence secret remained after redaction ({where}).
resultsui.findings.footer: {count, plural, =0 {No findings} one {# finding} other {# findings}} from {checks, plural, one {# check} other {# checks}} · by severity · excluded by review {excluded}
resultsui.findings.noMatch: No finding matches the search and filters.
resultsui.check.reviewed: Outcome set by your recorded review. The original automatic outcome “{auto}” is in the inspector.
resultsui.evidence.footer: Evidence is kept locally in AYAR’s data, and the fingerprint proves it has not changed since the run. Redactions show as “Redacted” and the value is never kept.
resultsui.effects.createdMany: Created ({count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}})
resultsui.effects.modifiedMany: Modified ({count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}})
resultsui.effects.deletedMany: Deleted ({count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}})
resultsui.effects.tracked: A tracked file outside the declared outputs
resultsui.effects.footer: Side effects recorded during the run in the project folder. AYAR writes to the repository only through an approved command that declares it (“Writes to project”).
resultsui.effects.empty: No side effect was recorded in the project folder.
resultsui.reportFailed: The report could not be built ({code}).
resultsui.next.stopped: Re-run incomplete: {count, plural, one {# check was} other {# checks were}} cancelled before ending
